messages:
samir: deploy-bot flagged a promotion attempt from staging -> prod for payments-service. postupgrade Job payments-migrate failed during canary. Chart in staging was bumped to 3.4.0; prod is still on 3.3.2. eu-west values overlay has new db.poolSize and migratorRole. promotion blocked, please advise. @mike can you triage?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] promotion blocked: postupgrade hook failed. job/payments-migrate exited with code 1. Logs: https://deploy-logs/1768882345. Auto-retry queued but will pause for manual resolution.

mike: reading logs now. seeing `psql: error: role \"payments_migrator\" does not exist` from the migration container. looks like staging overlay added a `migratorRole` value. @ashley did you change role name or creds in the staging overlay? :thinking_face: 

ashley: yup — yesterday I updated migration image and added `migratorRole: payments_migrator` in staging when pushing schema v5. I missed adding the same key to prod overlay. not ideal. Options: (A) patch prod overlay now and re-run promotion, (B) pin the release to keep prod on 3.3.2 and schedule a coordinated change window.

irene: prefer B. DB role changes are risky outside a scheduled window. pin chart to avoid accidental schema drift in prod.

samir: proposed plan: 1) abort the current promotion, 2) pin payments-service to chart 3.3.2 in deploy-bot, 3) add a release-tracker entry and release-note (hold + reason), 4) schedule a change window for coordinated migrator role + values push and migration run. mike/ashley to prepare a migration runbook. I'll apply the pin.

mike: ack. i'll prepare runbook and a preflight check. pin command i'll run: 
```
deployctl pin --service payments-service --chart 3.3.2 --reason "prod overlay missing migratorRole"
```
Can someone confirm deploy-bot halts retries for pinned promotions?

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] auto-retry suppressed for pinned releases. Pin recorded: samir at 1768882399. Audit entry created.

samir: pin applied and current promotion aborted. Draft release-note: "Hold: payments-service promotion blocked due to missing DB role (migratorRole) in prod overlay; pinned to chart 3.3.2. Follow-up: coordinated migration & overlay update scheduled for 2026-04-12 10:00 UTC." I'll add to release tracker.

ashley: i'll open a prod-overlay PR adding `migratorRole: payments_migrator` and include the migration image bump. link + runbook posted in PR. Runbook will include: preflight DB role presence check, staged migration command, expected rollback (reapply prev schema), and alerts to oncall.

mike: i'll add a pre-promotion canary that ensures the migration job completes with exit 0 and that the db role exists beforehand. test snippet i'll add to CI: 
```bash
kubectl run --rm migrate-check --image=psql-client --command -- sh -c "psql -c \"SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='payments_migrator'\""
```
If it fails, promotion will block and notify release manager.

irene: add a note for release manager to review DB migration plan during the change window. Also capture rollback decision: if migration mutates data irreversibly, we will postpone until twilight window.

samir: done. release tracker entry: https://redwood-inference/release-tracker/1768882345 ✅

ashley: PR opened: https://git/repo/prod-overlay/pull/872 — includes values change + migration image. Runbook in PR body. Will also include a manual verification checklist.

mike: i'll run staged migration in a staging clone and exercises the rollback steps, then mark the PR with status `preflight-passed`.

samir: okay. holding the pin until post-change-window sign-off. thanks team.
